title: TTC Domains
abstract: arXiv:2501.15422v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The Top Trading Cycles (TTC) rule is fundamental to object reallocation: it is the only rule that is individually rational, pair efficient, and strategyproof on the unrestricted domain. Despite its desirable properties, at some profiles, TTC precludes longer trading cycles that could lead to more appealing allocations. We explore restricted preference domains as an avenue for finding alternative rules satisfying the three axioms. Our main contribution is to introduce a richness condition on domains, the top-two condition, and show that it characterizes TTC domains: domains to which the above characterization of TTC extends. The condition requires that, within every subset of objects, any two objects that can each be ranked first can also be ranked as the top two, in both possible orders. translated_abstract: 顶级交易循环规则对物品再分配问题至关重要：在无限制偏好域上，它是唯一同时满足个体理性、成对效率和策略防操纵的规则。尽管TTC具有诸多优良性质，但在某些偏好组合下，TTC会排除那些可能带来更优配置的较长交易循环。我们探索受限制的偏好域，作为寻找满足上述三条公理的替代规则的途径。我们的主要贡献是引入了一个域丰富性条件——“前二条件”，并证明该条件刻画了TTC域：即上述关于TTC的刻画能够推广到的那类域。该条件要求：在每一个物品子集中，任何两个可以各自排名第一的物品，也能够以两种可能的顺序共同位列前二名。对于每一个不满足前二条件的域，我们都构造出一个不同于TTC的规则，该规则同样满足个体理性、帕累托效率和策略防操纵。
tldr: 本文提出偏好域上的“前二条件”，并证明它恰好刻画了TTC域——只有在此类域上，TTC才是唯一同时满足个体理性、（成对/帕累托）效率与策略防操纵的规则，而在任何其他域上都可构造出满足这些性质的替代规则。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "top-two condition," a richness condition on preference domains, and proves that it exactly characterizes the TTC domains on which TTC is the unique rule satisfying individual rationality, efficiency, and strategyproofness, while on any other domain alternative rules with these properties can be constructed.
